evaluation.tuned_on: the third of val kept for tuning

text: The slot holds the head `discriminant + sentences` for `tinyclip-8m-16` (shrinkage 0.03, species_com, gamma 3), fitted on `images/alachua-2025 (two thirds of val)`, with 5911 species rows, and a bias a row. Every photo's vector (`images/alachua-2025.wasm-int8-per-channel`) went through `tools/fusion/fuse.py`, the reference of the page's arithmetic, with the slot's own files as the page reads them (half-precision rows). Settings: rule `mix`, t_kind 50, w_kind 0.3, alpha_prior 0.5. On 565 tuning photos (the third of val kept for tuning) the thresholds came out as name_at 0.31 and offer_at 0.33. On the 4197 test photos the kind of eye is right for 77.5% (76.2 to 78.8); the top species is right for 25.6% (24.3 to 26.9) and is among the first five for 43.8% (42.3 to 45.3). `person` was said for 0.02% of these photos and `none` for 0.10%; the set holds neither. The top species from fuse.py differs from a direct matrix computation on the same files for 0 photos. The slot needs: species.bias_url (build 7 of the page); fusion.rule mix (build 7 of the page).
